composition.serve_who: This is drawing 108-01-520-001 (rev B), the "Bilge & Fire System Schematic" — it serves the vessel's Bilge and Fire System (node 520-bilge-system) as its authoritative system card, and every pump/valve/sensor tagged in its BOM table is a component of that one system, distributed across six sump zones (Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast Area, ESS Enclosure, Sail Locker) plus a dedicated fireline running fore-aft in the port sheer. Equipment nodes already established (520-main-bilge-pump, 520-fire-pump, 520-aux-bilge-pumps, 520-bilge-valves, 520-diesel-fire-pump, 520-feit-bilge-pump, 520-whale-pumps, 520-vega-bilge-level-sensors) each get their specific role-in-flow facts pulled from this sheet's BOM (item tags 001-025) and the lower schematic's drawn pipe walks. The BOM table and pipe-legend/pump-data table on this sheet are the identity authority for make/model/rating used below.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 001 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' qty2, drawn at both the aft bilge area (near frame G/engine room) and fwd bilge area (near frame B, fwd stowage) feeding the main bilge line (cyan, mw-marked sea54). facts: Sheet is drawing 108-01-520-001 rev B 'Bilge & Fire System Schematic', to be read with '108-01-520-002 Bilge & Fire System Operating Modes' and thru-hull valve sizes per '108-01-504-002'.

Fireline (red, sea42 metallic 38mm, ISO7840 marine fuel hose rated) runs continuously in the port sheer from aft fire pump station to fwd fire pump station, tee-ing at each zone frame (M,L,K,J,I,H,G,F,E,D,C,B,A) to hydrant stations; two pressure relief valves (3bar, item 008) protect each end of the line.

Main bilge line (cyan, sea54 metallic) runs the length of the vessel from aft to fwd, tee-ing into each sump zone through a motor-actuated isolation valve (item016/017); joins at the main bilge pump on each end (aft near lazarette, fwd near sail locker).

Six sump zones drawn as distinct boxes: Lazarette Sump, Midship Sump, Engine Room Sump, Mast Area Sump, ESS Enclosure, Sail Locker Sump — each with its own strumbox (item006), bilge alarm sensor (item007), and connection point to either the main bilge line or a local aux pump.
Fire hydrant stations at frame M (aft) and frame D/B (fwd) each comprise: fire hydrant valve (018), coiled fire hose (019, 7kg, max reach 18m per red dashed arc shown on plan), and nozzle (020).

Emergency engine-room flood suction capability exists via the STBD generator's Jabsco 43400 raw-water pump routed through the exhaust water separator overboard (established fact, not separately re-derived here).

Anti-siphon manifolds (item012, custom 316L/SS) at fwd stowage and engine room, each with a siphonbreak valve (item013) and a breather line running into the STBD E-R vent box (ref DWG 108-01-508-001), protecting against back-siphoning on overboard discharges.
Priming lines from the fresh water supply (ref DWG 108-01-510-001) feed both the diesel fire pump and electric fire pump for pre-start priming.
Portable oil storage tank fill points (2, one per engine-room-adjacent zone) are reached via Gardena-type tap connectors (item021) off the oily bilge filter and mast aux pump discharge branches.

uncertainties: Sail locker zone: it is unclear from the drawn lines whether a fully separate Whale Gulper aux pump exists there or whether the sail-locker sump simply tees into the main bilge line pump suction with only a strumbox — the sheet shows a strumbox (006-08) and strainer but no clearly separate pump symbol distinct from the main bilge line tee; flagged rather than assumed.

The ESS Enclosure sump's 'Coolant Leak Alarm' sensor (labelled 007-0x) — exact BOM item number is illegible; function (coolant leak detection in addition to bilge level) is clear but its own distinct tag could not be confirmed.

Ball valve 3-way item 015 (2" L-port) locations are listed in BOM but not clearly traced to a specific labelled position in the lower schematic beyond generic 'bilge line switching' — could not confirm exact zone.

Pump Data table row order: 'MAIN ENGINE RAW WATER PUMP — Cummins QSB4.5' appears in the same Pump Data table as the bilge/fire pumps; this pump belongs to the raw water/engine cooling system (610-cummins-qsb4-5), not the bilge/fire system — included in table only as reference data, not composed here as a bilge/fire function.
